reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness skill and optional host tool for dispatching tasks to 11 external agent CLIs and returning their results, making agent orchestration the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过无头命令行调用多个外部编程智能体，并将任务结果带回 DeepSeek Harness 会话。
summaries.en: Dispatches tasks to multiple external coding-agent CLIs in headless mode and brings their results back into a DeepSeek Harness session.

capabilities: Dispatches task text to external agent command-line interfaces
Executes configured local CLI commands in headless mode
Reads environment variables and local secret configuration files
Returns external CLI stdout as the agent response
May enable dispatched agents to write workspace files when configured
